ambient_events: The kettle reaches a rolling boil, clicks off, and begins to cool again.
Chalk dust drifts off the rota where a shift has just been rubbed out and rewritten.
description: A tiled alcove off the records hall: a bench, a kettle on a badly wired hotplate, and a duty rota chalked on the wall covering every hour. Mops stand in a bucket by the door. Cut into the tile above the bench: the date the water came in, and a death count, corrected downward in a second hand.
name: The Custodians' Station
